description: Recorded SEC EDGAR responses for Coherent Corp. (CIK 0000820318), replayed by atlas.sources.edgar_fixtures. SEC data is public domain. Bodies are the bytes SEC served (after gzip decoding), except where 'trimmed' says how a large body was cut. Recorded with 4 SEC requests (ticket 13); no 8-K was recorded, to stay within the 6-request budget (an 8-K needs its index headers plus each document).
